summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, reporting positive Phase III SANOVO trial results for Tagrisso plus Orpathys in first-line EGFR-mutated lung cancer with MET overexpression. The trial showed statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival versus Tagrisso alone. This is a routine clinical trial results announcement, not a special situation such as M&A, capital markets activity, or management change. The filing is informational, with no deal terms, board actions, or advisors. The registrant is the filer. No special-situations categorization applies; the only action is a routine product development disclosure.
